title: Color
description: A named colour forming the palette used to visually classify related objects (RA R-055). What a colour stands for in a given network ('Backup / Veeam', 'main LAN', 'DMZ') is written in metadata.comment, like for every other object. Songbird ships a predefined palette (examples/valid/objects/palette.yaml) whose hex values are fixed; users annotate their comment and add new Color objects. Other objects reference a Color by name in metadata.color; the reference is checked by the validator. Colors live in their own namespace.

metadata.description: A Color cannot itself have a 'color'.

predefined.description: True for entries of the shipped palette: their hex is immutable (validator check) so palettes stay recognisable across installations; the comment is free.
